profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Sphinx AI | MIT EECS | MIT Physics

positions.title: AI Software Engineer
positions.description: RA Capital is a healthcare and life sciences investment firm. I build agentic AI systems that bring LLM capabilities into the investment workflow, owning projects end-to-end from scoping through production deployment. This has included an automated research pipeline for investment analysts, a full-stack data analytics platform built with agentic coding tools, and multi-agent chatbot and text-to-SQL systems for querying proprietary financial data.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on a wireless health data collection system for a mounted medical device, utilizing radio signals and machine learning algorithms to generate actionable health metrics.

positions.title: Graduate Researcher
positions.description: Published a paper detailing work exploring methods of selection for large language model for different tasks.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher, Computer Vision Group
positions.description: Worked on project to use diffusion models to in order to solve hard inverse problem in computer vision.

company.name: MIT Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence Laboratory (CSAIL)

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Worked on natural language processing tools for call centers, utilizing models for automatic speech recognition and sentiment analysis to generate analytics.
